title: Cole's Thursday
notes: Outline, stage 2, side quest: "Cole invites you to [Tuck's] after the shift. Going isn't wrong. The test is which card you play once you're there." Claude's draft.
Claude's guess on the open question: Cole stays a coworker who drinks. He's funny, generous, and drifting the same way you are. He isn't the problem.
Going starts the encounter at the bar, against the negotiating voice: "Just this once. You've been good."

ask.speaker: [Cole]
text: [Cole] catches you at the truck, hard hat under his arm. "[Tuck's]. You, me, a couple guys from the crew. First round's mine."
He means it. He always means it. That's the nice thing about [Cole].

choices.label: "I'm in."
result: "There it is." He slaps the roof of your truck like it agreed too.

choices.label: "Can't tonight. Pantry."
result: "Look at you." He doesn't make fun of it. "Next week, then."

effects.objective: You said no. He said next week.

choices.label: "Not tonight."
result: "Suit yourself. Friday, then." He's already texting somebody else.

effects.objective: You said no. He said Friday.
